records.jp: ごめんなさいっっ！！！！
records.en_original: I'm so sorry!!!!
records.en_auxiliary: I'm so sorry!!!!
records.en: I'm so sorry!!!!

records.jp: 勇希は一度死んでいて……
records.en_original: Yuki has already died once...
records.en_auxiliary: Yuki has already died once...
records.en: Yuki has already died once...

records.jp: 世界システムによって魂を作り変えられて、<CR>システムの一部として蘇った
records.en_original: Her soul was remade by the World System, and she came back as part of it.
records.en_auxiliary: Her soul was remade by the World System, and she came back as part of it.
records.en: Her soul was remade by the World System,<CR>and she was resurrected as part of it.

records.jp: そして今も、システムの差し金によってこの世界にいる
records.en_original: Even now, she's in this world as an agent.
records.en_auxiliary: Even now, she's in this world as an agent.
records.en: And even now, she is in this world at the System's behest.

records.jp: 勇希は「目」の役割を果たしていて、<CR>きららたちは常に居場所を知られている……
records.en_original: If Yuki acts as their eyes, does that mean it always knows where we are?
records.en_auxiliary: If Yuki acts as their eyes, does that mean it always knows where we are?
records.en: Yuki serves as its 'eye,'<CR>so it always knows where Kirara and the others are...

records.jp: うん……
records.en_original: Yeah...
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah...
records.en: Yeah...

records.jp: ……そうだったのか。気づかなかった……
records.en_original: I see... I didn't realize...
records.en_auxiliary: I see... I didn't realize...
records.en: I see... I didn't realize...

records.jp: なるほど。伶那への想い……<CR>“つながり”を逆に利用されたということか
records.en_original: Now I see. Her feelings for Rena... Their connection was used against us.
records.en_auxiliary: Now I see. Her feelings for Rena... Their connection was used against us.
records.en: I see. Her feelings for Rena...<CR>Her connection to Rena was used against us.

records.jp: ……勇希を見捨てない。<CR>みんなのその判断は尊重したい<CR>
records.en_original: I will respect everyone's decision to not abandon Yuki...
records.en_auxiliary: I will respect everyone's decision to not abandon Yuki...
records.en: ...I want to respect everyone's decision<CR>not to abandon Yuki.<CR>

records.jp: ただ……それを突き通すには、<CR>相応のリスクが伴う
records.en_original: However, going through with this is incredibly risky...
records.en_auxiliary: However, going through with this is incredibly risky...
records.en: But... seeing that decision through<CR>will carry considerable risk.

records.jp: 勇希がいる限り……あいつらは必ずまた、襲ってくる
records.en_original: As long as Yuki is here, we can be sure it will mount another attack.
records.en_auxiliary: As long as Yuki is here, we can be sure it will mount another attack.
records.en: As long as Yuki is here... they are certain to attack again.

records.jp: うん。しっかり、考えていく必要があると思う
records.en_original: Yeah. We need to think this through.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah. We need to think this through.
records.en: Yeah. We need to think this through.

records.jp: 一つ考えているのは、勇希の存在が<CR>私たちの生存を保証してくれてるんじゃないかってこと
records.en_original: It's possible that Yuki being here is proof that we're all still alive.
records.en_auxiliary: It's possible that Yuki being here is proof that we're all still alive.
records.en: One thing I've been thinking is that Yuki's presence<CR>may prove that we're still alive.

records.jp: どういう意味？
records.en_original: What do you mean?
records.en_auxiliary: What do you mean?
records.en: What do you mean?

records.jp: ここにいる全員が死んでるんだとしたら、<CR>勇希を送り込む必要なんかない
records.en_original: If we were all dead, there'd be no reason for them to send Yuki.
records.en_auxiliary: If we were all dead, there'd be no reason for them to send Yuki.
records.en: If everyone here were dead,<CR>there would be no need to send Yuki in.

records.jp: だから勇希がいるってことは、<CR>私たちは生きてるってことなんじゃないかなって
records.en_original: So I was thinking, the fact that Yuki is here must mean that we're still alive.
records.en_auxiliary: So I was thinking, the fact that Yuki is here must mean that we're still alive.
records.en: So the fact that Yuki is here<CR>may mean that we are alive.

records.jp: そうだね……。そこは間違いないと思う
records.en_original: Yes... I think you're right.
records.en_auxiliary: Yes... I think you're right.
records.en: Yes... I think you're right.

records.jp: それが分かっただけでも心強いよ。<CR>戻ってきてくれてありがとう、勇希
records.en_original: Just knowing that is reassuring. Thanks for coming back, Yuki.
records.en_auxiliary: Just knowing that is reassuring. Thanks for coming back, Yuki.
records.en: Just knowing that is reassuring.<CR>Thank you for coming back, Yuki.

records.jp: はい。すごく難しい状況ですけど……<CR>こうしてまた会って話せて、本当に良かったです
records.en_original: Yes, these are not the best of circumstances, but I'm glad that we could all meet again and talk like this.
records.en_auxiliary: Yes, these are not the best of circumstances, but I'm glad that we could all meet again and talk like this.
records.en: Yes. It is an extremely difficult situation...<CR>but I'm truly glad we could meet and talk again.

records.jp: みんな……ありがとう
records.en_original: Thank you...everyone.
records.en_auxiliary: Thank you...everyone.
records.en: Thank you, everyone.

records.jp: 私たちは考え方が甘かったんだ
records.en_original: We were naive.
records.en_auxiliary: We were naive.
records.en: We were naive.

records.jp: クラックの時の襲撃といい、勇希のことといい、<CR>世界システムは、本気で私たちを消しに来てる
records.en_original: With all that's happened with the battle at the Crack, and Yuki... The World System really is coming to erase us.
records.en_auxiliary: With all that's happened with the battle at the Crack, and Yuki... The World System really is coming to erase us.
records.en: Between the attack at the Crack and what happened with Yuki,<CR>the World System is seriously trying to erase us.

records.jp: ユズさんとライムさんが頑張ってくれたおかげで、<CR>どうにか今まで生き残ってるけど……
records.en_original: Thanks to Yuzu and Lime's hard work, we've managed to survive until now, but...
records.en_auxiliary: Thanks to Yuzu and Lime's hard work, we've managed to survive until now, but...
records.en: Thanks to Yuzu-san and Lime-san's efforts,<CR>we've somehow survived this long, but...

records.jp: あんまり悠長に構えてもいられないね
records.en_original: Time is a luxury we don't have anymore.
records.en_auxiliary: Time is a luxury we don't have anymore.
records.en: Time is a luxury we don't have anymore.

records.jp: ……そうだね。あたしがいる限り、<CR>敵はいつまでも襲ってくる……
records.en_original: ...You're right. As long as I'm around, the enemy will continue to attack...
records.en_auxiliary: ...You're right. As long as I'm around, the enemy will continue to attack...
records.en: ...Right. As long as I am here,<CR>the enemy will keep attacking...

records.jp: 事情を理解した上で一緒にいる選択をしたんだ。<CR>気にしすぎちゃダメだよ、勇希
records.en_original: We knew the risks, and we made our choice. You don't need to worry, Yuki.
records.en_auxiliary: We knew the risks, and we made our choice. You don't need to worry, Yuki.
records.en: We understood the circumstances and chose to stay together.<CR>Do not worry too much, Yuki.

records.jp: ……うん
records.en_original: ...Okay.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Okay.
records.en: ...Okay.

records.jp: もし勇希がここにいることで<CR>敵が襲ってくるなら全部倒せばいい
records.en_original: If it tries and attacks because you're here, all we have to do is beat it.
records.en_auxiliary: If it tries and attacks because you're here, all we have to do is beat it.
records.en: If the enemy attacks because Yuki is here,<CR>then we simply defeat every last one of them.

records.jp: これはピンチじゃない。<CR>勇希も一緒に助かる、チャンスなんだから
records.en_original: We're not done for yet, this is a chance for us to save Yuki.
records.en_auxiliary: We're not done for yet, this is a chance for us to save Yuki.
records.en: This isn't a crisis.<CR>It's a chance for Yuki to survive with us.

records.jp: 愛央……
records.en_original: Ao...
records.en_auxiliary: Ao...
records.en: Ao...

records.jp: 私たちVS神。これは全面対決だよ
records.en_original: It's us against god. The ultimate showdown.
records.en_auxiliary: It's us against god. The ultimate showdown.
records.en: Us versus god. This is an all-out showdown.

records.jp: 神を倒して平和な世界を取り戻す……<CR>そうでしょ？　みんな
records.en_original: We're gonna take it down, and restore peace to the world... Okay everyone?
records.en_auxiliary: We're gonna take it down, and restore peace to the world... Okay everyone?
records.en: We defeat god and take back a peaceful world...<CR>Right, everyone?

records.jp: ということで……
records.en_original: And so...
records.en_auxiliary: And so...
records.en: And so...

records.jp: とりあえず今日は休もう！　いろいろあって、疲れた！
records.en_original: Let's call it a day for today! I'm tired!
records.en_auxiliary: Let's call it a day for today! I'm tired!
records.en: For now, let's rest today! A lot happened, and I'm exhausted!

records.jp: あはは、そうだね。休むのも大事なことだよ
records.en_original: Ahaha, I agree. It's important we stay rested.
records.en_auxiliary: Ahaha, I agree. It's important we stay rested.
records.en: Ahaha, yeah. Resting is important too.

records.jp: ほんと、今日が人生で一番疲れたかもしれない……
records.en_original: This may be the most tired I've ever felt...
records.en_auxiliary: This may be the most tired I've ever felt...
records.en: Today may have been the most exhausting day of my life...

records.jp: <CLGR>勇希<CLNR>のタレントに<CR>新たなタレントタイプが解放されました
records.en_original: A new Talent Type has been unlocked in <CLGR>Yuki's<CLNR> Talents.
records.en_auxiliary: A new Talent Type has been unlocked in <CLGR>Yuki's<CLNR> Talents.
records.en: A new Talent Type has been unlocked<CR>in <CLGR>Yuki's<CLNR> Talents.
